title: $MELANIA coin and NFTs
summary: Melania Trump did launch $MELANIA on Jan 19, 2025, about two days after $TRUMP, and the token is down roughly 99% from its $13+ peak, which is confirmed. The '$6 million' figure is real ($6,011,259 on the President's 2025 disclosure). That income was listed as NFT/digital-collectible sales under a licensing deal, not as meme-coin proceeds. It was also reported as spouse income on Donald Trump's filing, not in a report of her own.

sub_claims.statement: Melania launched her own meme coin right after $TRUMP, before the inauguration.
sub_claims.finding: $MELANIA launched on Solana on Jan 19, 2025, announced on X, about two days after $TRUMP (Jan 17/18) and one day before the Jan 20 inauguration. It was issued via MKT World LLC.

sub_claims.statement: Melania reported ~$6 million from her coin and NFTs.
sub_claims.finding: The 2025 OGE 278e, released Jun 30, 2026, lists $6,011,259 to Melania from the sale of NFTs and other digital collectibles under a license with Designers Manager, about 28x her 2024 figure. It lists no $MELANIA coin proceeds; CAP attributes the income to the coin and digital ventures by its own inference. The filing is Donald Trump's, with this as spouse income. Her total 2025 income was about $17.2M, mostly from the Amazon documentary.

sub_claims.statement: Molly White tracked the shell companies behind Melania's coin/NFT income.
sub_claims.finding: MKT World LLC (Florida) issues $MELANIA and receives NFT and speaking income, per DL News. Molly White tracks Trump crypto ventures generally, but no specific piece of hers on Melania's entities was found. 'Shell companies' is the video's characterization.

The peak was about $13.05-$13.73 (Jan 19-20, 2025). The ATL was about $0.066 on Jun 6, 2026, and it traded around $0.08-0.087 in late Oct 2026, about 99.4% below peak. It was about 95% down by Mar 2025 and 98% down later in 2025. $TRUMP's drawdown is smaller.

corrections: Transcript says Melania 'reported $6 million on her coin and NFTs'; the disclosure lists $6,011,259 from NFTs/digital collectibles (licensing via Designers Manager) and no meme-coin proceeds.
The figure appears as spouse income on Donald Trump's 2025 OGE 278e (released 2026-06-30), not a report filed by Melania herself.
Transcript's 'meme point' is an auto-transcription error for 'meme coin'.
denials_and_context: No public response from Melania Trump's office or the White House on the coin's collapse or the disclosure was found.

A 2025 class action alleged that Meteora co-founder Benjamin Chow and Hayden Davis/Kelsier ran a pump-and-dump scheme on MELANIA (about $10M allegedly extracted by insiders). Melania was not a defendant and was described as a 'prop'. A NY federal judge reportedly dismissed related claims and declined to add MELANIA, per one outlet and not confirmed on the docket.
SEC staff said in Feb 2025 that meme coins generally are not securities; no court or regulator has alleged wrongdoing by Melania Trump.
Most of Melania's ~$17.2M 2025 income came from the Amazon documentary (~$10.7M net), not crypto.
